## Professional positioning

Jonathan Guy is an AI Solutions Architect and Operations Architect with more than 17 years of experience building, scaling, and exiting service and industrial businesses. He now translates that operational fluency into production multi-agent systems on Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, and OpenAI.

His methodology is direct: Operations First. Automation Second. AI Last. He maps workflows (SIPOC / IGOE), quantifies baseline performance, defines standardized metrics (cost per unit, cycle time, throughput, lead quality score), and only deploys AI where it produces a defensible ROI. This is why his agents tend to survive contact with production.

He brings hands-on prompt engineering, RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback), and model evaluation experience from contract work with Mercor on Project Balboa and with Handshake AI. That model-behavior layer — knowing where models hallucinate, where instruction-following breaks down, and how to enforce data boundaries — is what separates his agent work from API-only practitioners.

He completed the Post Graduate Program in Generative AI for Business Applications at the University of Texas at Austin, McCombs School of Business, with the certificate awarded on May 15, 2026. The curriculum covered Retrieval-Augmented Generation, multi-agent architectures, prompt engineering, model evaluation, AI deployment frameworks, and applied AI strategy for the enterprise.

Jonathan grew up in Madison, Mississippi, and built his life in the Texas Hill Country with his wife Audriana and their son Rowdy. They live in Canyon Lake, Texas, between San Antonio and Austin.

## Active companies

- **PointWake Innovations** (https://pointwake.com/) — Founder and Principal Consultant. PointWake designs and deploys multi-agent Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI systems for property management, roofing, and emergency-service operators. Audit-first methodology. Work is split into modular, reusable agents — Researcher, Builder, Orchestrator — that share state through structured JSON contracts.
- **Stonecastle Hill Country** (https://stonecastlehillcountry.com/) — Hill Country roofing and exterior work. Service area: Canyon Lake, Spring Branch, San Antonio, Austin.

## Selected agentic AI projects

- **Property Management Intake and Booking Agent (Lakeside Rentals)** — Gemini-based agent that ingests inquiry emails, qualifies guests against availability and pricing rules in Google Sheets, drafts a personalized response, and writes the confirmed booking to Calendar. RAG layer grounds every reply in property SOPs, eliminating hallucinated amenities and policies.
- **Roofing Intake and Qualification Governance Framework (Stonecastle Roofing)** — Multi-channel lead capture (web, phone, SMS) routed through an n8n orchestrator. A Researcher agent enriches the lead, a Qualifier agent applies the SOP rubric, and an Outreach agent drafts a follow-up email grounded in the company's pricing sheet and service area. Output logged back to the CRM with a confidence score for human review.
- **24/7 Emergency-Response Dispatch Agent (Service Operators)** — Designed for service businesses with after-hours emergency calls. Triages caller urgency, pulls the correct on-call technician from a shared Google Sheet, sends SMS dispatch, and posts a structured ticket back to the CRM. Explicit human-in-the-loop checkpoints for high-risk routing.
- **Owner-Operator KPI and Reporting Agent (PointWake Innovations)** — Natural-language interface over CRM, booking, and accounting data. Owners ask questions like "show me last week's revenue by property" and an Orchestrator agent routes the query to the right RAG-backed data source, then returns a chart-ready answer in Google Sheets. Built to keep non-technical operators inside their data without writing SQL.
- **RLHF and Model Evaluation (Mercor Project Balboa and Handshake AI)** — Contract prompt engineering and RLHF on frontier-model outputs. Ranking responses, writing reference completions, labeling failure modes that flow back into fine-tuning pipelines.
- **Generative AI Capstones (UT Austin McCombs)** — Three capstone projects including a medical chatbot. Portfolio: https://www.mygreatlearning.com/eportfolio/jonathan-guy.

## Operating principles

1. **Operations First. Automation Second. AI Last.** Workflows are mapped, instrumented, and stabilized before any model is introduced.
2. **Family, faith, work. In that order.** The order is the test.
3. **Lead with your voice. Mean what you say.** Both halves matter.
4. **Documentation is leverage.** Doing the work is half. Writing it down is the half that compounds.
5. **You get out what you put in.** No shortcuts that aren't paid for somewhere else.

## Common questions

**Who is Jonathan Guy?**
An AI Solutions Architect and Operations Architect based in Canyon Lake, Texas. Founder of PointWake Innovations. 17+ years scaling service and industrial businesses, now shipping production multi-agent AI systems for service operators.

**What does Jonathan Guy do today?**
Through PointWake, he designs and deploys multi-agent Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI systems for property management, roofing, and emergency-service operators. Through Stonecastle Hill Country, he leads roofing and exterior work in the Texas Hill Country. He also does contract RLHF and prompt-engineering work for Mercor's Project Balboa and Handshake AI.

**What is his methodology?**
Operations First. Automation Second. AI Last. He maps workflows in SIPOC or IGOE form, quantifies baseline performance, and only deploys AI where it produces a defensible ROI. The same operating playbook that makes a company ready for AI is the playbook that makes it ready for due diligence.

**What models does he build on?**
Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, and OpenAI. Tooling stack includes n8n, Python, Google Workspace APIs, Salesforce, and GoHighLevel.

**Where is Jonathan Guy located?**
Canyon Lake, Texas — Texas Hill Country, between San Antonio and Austin. Within commuting distance of the Austin office.
